|champion     = Nilah
|skill        = I

|icon2       = Nilah Joy Unending.png
|blurbicon= Nilah Joy Unending.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Nilah}} kills a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied champion gain an additional portion of the {{as|{{sti|experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nilah''' shares a bonus portion of {{tip|heal|healing}} or {{tip|shield|shielding}} with nearby allied champions that apply healing or shielding to her or themselves.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Nilah''' [[kill]]s a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied {{tip|champion}} gain an additional {{sti|{{as|50% of the experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby allied champion uses an {{tip|ability}} to {{tip|heal}} or {{tip|shield}} either '''Nilah''' or themselves, both they and '''Nilah''' receive a '''bonus''' amount equal to {{fd|7.5}}% of the healing or 15% of the shielding after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. '''Bonus''' shielding lasts as long as the shield that triggered the effect, up to a maximum duration of 4 seconds.
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1000|Healing and shielding interaction radius}}

|angle        =

|notes        = 
* '''Nilah''' will gain a portion of all healing and all shielding from nearby allies that activate either of the effects on themselves while she is within range of them.
** The same applies to allies that grant '''Nilah''' a heal or shield; they gain a portion of the heal or shield given to her by them, even if the heal or shield affects both units.
* Heal and shields granted by [[item]]s, [[rune]]s, and [[summoner spell]]s will '''not''' trigger the increased amount.
* The heal and shield increases do not trigger from their own heal or shield.
* '''Nilah''' may still gain a shield from her allies' shields even if they are longer than 4 seconds, but the buff of the shield will only last for up to 4 seconds.
* '''Nilah''' can receive a normal shield from nearby allies that gain [[Shield#Physical shields|physical]] or [[Shield#Magic shields|magic]] shields.

|champion         = Nilah
|skill            = R
|icon             = Nilah Apotheosis.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nilah}} whirls her whip-blade for a brief moment, continually dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. She then bursts to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pull in}} nearby enemies. Each hit will also {{tip|slow}} enemies for a short time.
|blurb2      = '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for a portion of the damage dealt to {{tip|champions}}, based on her {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}, and converting overhealing into {{tip|shield|shielding}} that lasts for a moderate amount of time.
|blurb4      = '''Nilah''' can move during ''Apotheosis''.

She then unleashes a burst that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them 250 units towards her. Each hit also {{tip|slows}} targets by 10% for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
